responsibility: Implements the gcc-ar/gcc-ranlib/gcc-nm style wrapper executable that locates the corresponding binutils tool and injects GCC’s LTO plugin when available. It is responsible for reconstructing relocated exec/libexec/tool search prefixes, honoring an optional -B prefix, finding the target-qualified underlying program and plugin shared object, normalizing ar’s first non-dashed mode argument, and then executing the wrapped tool through pex so archive and symbol-table operations can understand LTO objects.
